properties.name: Karimganj scenario: rivers 5 m above the terrain data's water surface
properties.source: NodiBondhu HAND model using Copernicus DEM GLO-30 and rivers from OpenStreetMap contributors
properties.quality: Screening estimate only. Terrain is a surface model with several metres of vertical error on flat land. Ignores embankments, flow, timing and channel changes. Not checked against a real flood yet. Only land inside the district boundary is counted, not land in Bangladesh
